title: NSF moves to overhaul funding approach in line with White House priorities
title_zh: NSF拟调整资助方式以配合白宫优先事项
abstract: The major funder of basic science has not said how its new initiatives will be funded — but staff worry that streamlined approach will further squeeze cash for core sciences.
abstract_zh: 基础科学的主要资助者尚未说明其新举措的资金来源——但工作人员担心精简化的做法将进一步压缩核心科学的经费。
snippet: The major funder of basic science has not said how its new initiatives will be funded — but staff worry that streamlined approach will further squeeze cash for core sciences.
